introHtml: Custom yoga nursing scrubs combine the flexibility needed for stretching and movement with the professional appearance required in healthcare settings. Made from stretchable fabrics like spandex blends, these scrubs allow nurses to lead or participate in wellness activities without changing clothes. Ideal for hospital yoga classes, team-building events, or branded wellness programs, they can be decorated with embroidery or heat transfer logos. Choose from moisture-wicking materials to keep cool during active sessions.
